dataList.content:
So there isn't anyone left...
无人幸存。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Laboratory
呼啸山庄 实验室

dataList.content:
I won't last much longer.
我也撑不了多久了。

This is how I was born. How I've lived my entire life.
我就是这样出生的，就是这样生活的。

Yeah. Glad you know that. So why don't you—
嗯，明白了的话那你就差不多老实点……

What... admit my sins and... surrender...?
是要我全部认罪……然后……投降吗？

Ha ha... why would any of that ever matter to me?
哈哈……你觉得那对我来说到底有什么意义呢？

Linton looks up with a lighter expression, as though a burden has been lifted from his shoulders.
林顿以如释重负般的轻松表情望向上方。

This is as far as I will go.
我肯定就到此为止了吧。

Then, with the gentlest voice, he begins speaking to... someone.
然后他对着某人以温柔的声音组织起了话语。

His voice was overflowing with intense, fervent affection.
其中满溢出强烈而炽热的爱。

As I have always told you... I have no regrets.
如我常言那般，我不后悔。

I merely think that... we were both walking in different paces.
我想，只是我们没有以同样的速度前行罢了。

And you always happened to walk ahead of me.
你一直比我走得更快。

Yet, even a sight of you from behind summoned butterflies in my stomach.
即便如此，我只是看着你的背影，内心就已无比满足了。

This man will die without immediate and appropriate medical attention from a professional doctor. He is extremely weakened.
如果没有主治医生采取适当的治疗措施，那个人大概会很快死去。他现处于极度衰弱的状态。

Still...
就算如此……

Catherine, I wish you would...
凯瑟琳，我还是希望……

... I wish my death would bring you even a trace of sorrow.
哪怕只有一点点也好……你能为我而感到悲伤。

Even before I first laid my eyes upon that child, Linton...
在我初次和那个叫林顿的孩子视线相对之前……

... he was watching me.
那孩子就已经在注视着我了。

Unable to look away, even for a moment.
连一分一秒，都没有将视线从我的身上移开。

That child is wealthy. He looks like the prince charming from fairy tales of my childhood.
那孩子不仅富有，还像绘本里走出来的王子一样。

And he loves me so, so much.
而且他非常喜欢我。

See? His eyes glimmer like the very stars of the night sky with every second he lays them upon me.
看吧。每当他看到我的时候，眼睛便会如明星般闪烁。

I love Linton who loves me.
我啊，爱着那爱着我的林顿。

His eyes that twinkle for no one else but me.
爱着他那只为我闪耀的双瞳。

His flaxen locks that flow for no one else but me.
爱着他那只为我飘舞的金发。

His radiant smile that flashes for no one else but me.
爱着他那只为我展露的明媚笑颜。

Linton, who finds happiness through nothing else but me.
爱着那不因其他任何事物，只因我一人而感到幸福的林顿。

When light returned to the manor, when I could finally see again...
当光明再度降临宅邸，视线变得开朗之时……

There stood Linton, wearing the brightest, happiest smile I had ever seen.
林顿带着无比恍惚的表情笑了起来。

... The machines of the laboratory were linked to his body.
他的身上连接着实验装置。

Ah... did you hear... the thunder...?
啊……听到了吗？闪电终于落下来了。

Catherine weeps for me.
凯瑟琳因我而感到痛苦了。

Oh... Catherine!
啊……凯瑟琳！

Linton musters every strength in his body and reaches out toward Catherine's coffin.
林顿拼尽全力，向着凯瑟琳的棺材伸出手。

Wait, what are you—
等等……你现在想……

So now... is the right moment to...
所以……差不多也到时间了……

... STOP!
……住手！

I thought I saw tears of joy rolling down his cheeks, but...
我似乎看到了喜悦的泪水从林顿的脸上流下，但……

... they were his flesh beginning to melt off his face.
仔细一看，那是他渐渐融化的脸。

Even if you will not permit me into your chambers... It's all right.
就算你不让我进入你的房间……也没关系。

I will await you within its walls forevermore.
我会被困在这墙壁中，永远等着你。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
To bring forth the pure form of humanity that once existed... was quite the simple task.
创造一个曾经存在过的纯粹的人类的方法……很简单。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
You never had any talent in the culinary arts, Yi Sang. So you wouldn't understand.
哪怕回炉重造也无法拥有烹饪天赋的你是不会明白的，李箱。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Any kind of Identity could safely and securely be applied to it, as long as the 'dough' is in its purest form.
如果“面团”里没有任何杂质……那么无论其披上了何种人格，都能安全地融合在一起。

What happened to... Linton?
林顿先生……到底会怎么样？

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Can't you see? He's become a dough, a batter; a pure being free of dregs.
你没看见吗？他变成了一个没有杂质的完美面团。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
So that it would always yield the finest results, regardless of what other ingredients you mix into it.
以至于无论与什么混合都能获得最棒的成果。

You call that mass of flesh... human?
那样的一堆肉块……你还称他为人类？

... No. Creation of a new human is but a stepping stone in that process.
……不，这无非是创造一个新的人类的过程罢了……

Their ultimate goal must be to go even further beyond that 'dough'; they seek to reach the very origin... the primordial human. This is but a part of that process, merely an experiment along the way.
他们最终的目标是创造出超越之前提到的“面团”的，还在那之前曾存在的原初的人类。现在的状况对于他们来说并非是结果，仅是实验而已吧。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Oh…
嚯……

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Consider yourself fortunate that there aren't any other surviving researchers here other than myself.
你应该为我是这里唯一活着的研究人员而感到庆幸。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
If Director Hermann or any of the other higher-ups heard what you said, I'm sure they would be pulling all kinds of strings to take you in.
如果赫尔曼董事这样的高层听到了你这番话，一定会想尽一切办法来抓你的吧。

Mother... dammit, I knew that woman would be...!
母亲……妈的，果然那个人……

The 'dough', the being you refer to as a human... I presume that one could apply any Identity from any possibility, no matter how distant and irrelevant the world, to that being...
被制成的……那个面团，那个你称之为人类的东西……那种存在，就算是来自毫无接点的世界中存在的多么微小的可能性，都能以完全的人格寄宿其中……

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Yes, Yi Sang. I knew that you would be most overjoyed to hear of this breakthrough.
是的，李箱，我想你对此一定比任何人都要喜悦吧。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
This is the apex of what the Mirror technology is capable of.
我们已经达到了镜子技术的顶点。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Now all we have left to do is to leap from that apex, to soar beyond its limits.
现在剩下的就只有朝着彼方的最后一跃。

From what we know, there is... another Golden Bough located inside the manor.
我们已经掌握到……宅邸中还存在着另一根金枝。

This 'dough' is a part of an experiment that can be conducted only with a preposterous magnitude of energy output.
这个“面团”是只有聚集大量能量才能进行的实验。

So the Golden Bough to accumulate that much energy...
为了聚集能量的……金枝……

... must be located on the rooftop of this manor.
……必定位于这座宅邸的屋顶。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Correct. The Golden Bough acts as a lightning rod, draws the merciless strikes of lightning, then harnesses it into a form of energy for itself. Your breadth of knowledge is starting to get unsettling.
没错，它不仅收集着这座宅邸周围无情劈下的闪电，同时也充当了凝聚金枝之力的避雷针。你的洞察力足以让我胆寒啊。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Well, now that everything is in order... I must really make my exit.
好的，既然一切都准备好了……那我差不多也该退场了。

Not so fast! I'll get you and find out everything you know about what mother is planning—
你准备去哪？这次我一定要抓住你，让你吐出有关我母亲计划的信息……！

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Please, let us not waste each other's time by playing this pointless game of cat and mouse.
我希望你不要浪费不必要的时间来抓我。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
When the perfected Identity is applied over a dough, one such opaque, murky mist emerges. What a picturesque moment, most apt to bid you all farewell, is it not?
当其披上处于完美状态下的人格的时候，这种朦胧的烟雾就会笼罩整个地方。难道还有比这更雅致的告别方式吗？

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Director Hermann's son, was it? I hear that you are a veteran of the Smoke War. Then perhaps this may be a familiar sight to you, if a tad different in a few places.
你说你是赫尔曼董事的儿子吗。听说你参加了烟霾战争。那你说不定会对这番光景有些熟悉，虽说也有些许不同。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
And Yi Sang, my dear fellow.
而你……李箱。我的朋友啊。

dataList.title:
N Corp.
N公司
dataList.content:
Live. So that I may have aught to look forward to in the time I have left.
活下去。只有这样，我才能对自己剩下的未来多期待些许。
